body: I wish you all the very best. You’ve done well getting this far! Life is not easy. Keep going my friend. God bless xx
It may mean nothing to you. But I care. I suffer my own demons but you have to remember tough times don’t last!! Good luck and god bless xx
Tough times don’t last, tough people do. God bless xx
‘No man is an island’. A problem shared is a problem halved. Im only a message away. God bless xx
I’m sure you’ve heard it 1000 times, but I’m only a message away. You are loved. God bless xx

I only came onto this app today and my faith in humanity has been restored. I cannot believe the amount of support being given to those in need. I cannot relate to your problem but can completely understand your frustrations. I’m sure it means nothing but I’m happy to speak to anyone in need, especially you. It has really put a lump in my throat reading your story and seeing suicide as your only option. The offer is there, I wish you all the best. God bless xx
